content: Definition of optional elements on the level of Applica- tionDataType The modeling approach for the definition of optional elements on the level of ApplicationDataType is to set the attribute ApplicationRecordEle- ment . isOptional to the value true . If the attribute is not set or set to the value false then the respective Application- RecordElement shall be considered mandatory .
